acceptance_criteria.detail: Focused and full tests passed without code changes.
A missing historical PIT policy exited 2 and did not create the snapshot output directory.
Decision-date membership changed from industry-a to industry-b while current metadata stayed current-a; live-current snapshots were rejected by research paths.

direct_evidence: Missing historical policy: CLI exited 2; stderr required an explicit PIT policy or config/pit-universe.v32.json; no snapshot output directory was created.
Historical membership: 000001 resolved as industry-a on 2026-01-20 and industry-b on 2026-01-25 while current metadata remained current-a.
Historical snapshot manifest: pit_ready=true and industry_source=pit_membership.
Live-current manifest: snapshot_mode=live_current, industry_source=current_metadata, industry_lookahead_safe=false, pit_ready=false.
Live-current snapshots were rejected by discovery, portfolio backtest, research loop, parameter optimization, and snapshot binding.
